patch.summary:
Thesis: Same category, different company size — Both sit in business-communications, but documented company-size audiences diverge.

Frame: Same category, different company size — Both sit in business-communications, but documented company-size audiences diverge.. Choose Genesys only if your buying job matches “Enterprise CCaaS (Genesys Cloud CX) — CX 1 from $75/user/mo annual; CX 2 $115; CX 3 $155; ” rather than Grasshopper's shape. Choose Grasshopper only if your buying job matches “SMB virtual business numbers with extensions and apps — True Solo from $14/month annual (f” rather than Genesys's shape. Workflow advantage: Genesys leans contact-center, customer-messaging; Grasshopper leans business-phone. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Same category, different company size — Both sit in business-communications, but documented company-size audiences diverge.
- Positioning: Genesys is Enterprise CCaaS (Genesys Cloud CX) — CX 1 from $75/user/mo annual; CX 2 $115; CX 3 $155; CX 4 $240.; Grasshopper is SMB virtual business numbers with extensions and apps — True Solo from $14/month annual (flat account, not per seat)..
- Company-size focus: Genesys (mid-market, enterprise) vs Grasshopper (solo, small-business).
- Workflow coverage skew: Genesys-leaning contact-center, customer-messaging, sales-calling vs Grasshopper-leaning business-phone.
- Researched limits: Genesys — Enterprise complexity and implementation cost — not an SMB self-serve phone; Grasshopper — Virtual-number / simple phone product — not full UCaaS (no native team chat or video meetings suite).

Limitations — Genesys: Enterprise complexity and implementation cost — not an SMB self-serve phone; CX 1 is voice-only; digital channels require CX 2 or digital add-ons; Grasshopper: Virtual-number / simple phone product — not full UCaaS (no native team chat or video meetings suite); IVR, recording and simultaneous ringing require Solo Plus or above.

Poor-fit cases: Genesys is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Enterprise complexity and implementation cost — not an SMB self-serve phone · Grasshopper is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Virtual-number / simple phone product — not full UCaaS (no native team chat or video meetings suite) · Avoid Genesys if you actually need Grasshopper's motion (SMB virtual business numbers with extensions and apps — True Solo from $14/month)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
